questionHinglish: Bura ya daravna khwab dekhne par kya karna chahiye?
questionEnglish: What should one do after seeing a bad or scary dream?
questionHindi: बुरा या डरावना ख़्वाब देखने पर क्या करना चाहिए?
hanafi: Baayi (left) taraf 3 baar thookne ka ishara karein, 'A'udhu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem' padhein, karwat badal lein, aur kisi ko na batayein. (Sahih Muslim 2261, Sahih al-Bukhari 6985)
shafii: Allah ki panah maangein, 3 baar left side halka ishara karein, uth kar 2 rakat nafl namaz padh sakte hain aur khwab kisi se zikr na karein. (Sahih Muslim 2261, 2263)
maliki: Bura khwab shaitan ki taraf se hota hai; iska koi bura asar nahi hota jab banda Allah ki panah maang le aur kisi ko na sunaye. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6985)
hanbali: 3 baar left side dry-spit karein, 3 baar Ta'awwudh padhein, karwat badlein, aur kisi se bayan na karein. (Sahih Muslim 2261)
jafari: Bure khwab se ghabrana nahi chahiye; A'udhu billah aur Ayat al-Kursi / 3 Qul padh kar Allah par bharosa rakhein aur sadqah de sakte hain.
ahleHadith: Sahih Muslim (2261) aur Sahih Bukhari (6985) ke mutabiq 3 baar left side ishara, Ta'awwudh, karwat badalna, aur kisi ko na batana Sunnat hai.
keywordsHinglish: khwab sapna dream bura daravna nightmare

questionHinglish: Namaz mein Surah Fatihah se pehle Bismillah zor se padhein ya aahista?
questionEnglish: Should Bismillah before Al-Fatihah in Salah be recited silently or aloud?
questionHindi: नमाज़ में सूरह फ़ातिहा से पहले बिस्मिल्लाह ज़ोर से पढ़ें या आहिस्ता?
hanafi: Bismillah aahista (dil mein) padhna Sunnat hai, kyunki Sahih Muslim (399) mein Anas (RA) se marwi hai ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr aur Umar (RA) namaz Alhamdulillah se shuru karte the.
shafii: Jahri namaz (Fajr, Maghrib, Isha) mein Bismillah buland aawaz se padhna Sunnat aur zaroori hai, kyunki Bismillah Surah Fatihah ki pehli ayat hai (Sunan ad-Daraqutni).
maliki: Farz namaz mein Bismillah na aahista aur na zor se padhna mashhoor Maliki amal hai (albatta aahista padhna jaiz hai).
hanbali: Bismillah ko aahista padhna Sunnat hai, bilkul Hanafi maslak ki tarah.
jafari: Har Surah (siwaye Taubah) ke shuru mein Bismillah buland aur wazeh aawaz se padhne ki takeed hai.
ahleHadith: Aahista padhna afzal aur aksar sahih riwayaat ke mutabiq hai, jabki kabhi-kabhi buland aawaz se padhna bhi jaiz hai (Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah).
keywordsHinglish: bismillah namaz salah fatiha aahista zor

questionHinglish: Imam ke peeche 'Ameen' aahista kahein ya buland aawaz se?
questionEnglish: Should 'Ameen' after Al-Fatihah be said silently or aloud?
questionHindi: इमाम के पीछे 'आमीन' आहिस्ता कहें या बुलंद आवाज़ से?
hanafi: Aahista (sirran) Ameen kehna afzal hai (Jami' at-Tirmidhi 248 ke tehat Wail ibn Hujr ki riwayat aur Ibrahim an-Nakha'i ka amal).
shafii: Jahri namazon mein Imam aur Muqtadi dono ka buland aawaz se Ameen kehna Sunnat hai (Sahih al-Bukhari 780).
maliki: Muqtadi aahista Ameen kahein aur Imam jahri namaz mein aahista ya halka kahein (Muwatta Imam Malik).
hanbali: Jahri namaz mein buland aawaz se Ameen kehna Sunnat hai (Sunan Abi Dawud 932).
jafari: Namaz mein Surah Fatihah ke baad 'Ameen' nahi kaha jata; iski jagah 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen' kehna mustahab hai.
ahleHadith: Jahri namazon mein buland aawaz se Ameen kehna Sunnat hai (Sahih al-Bukhari 780, Sunan Ibn Majah 851).
keywordsHinglish: ameen amin namaz fatiha aahista zor

questionHinglish: Ruku mein jaate aur uthte waqt haath uthana (Rafa-ul-Yadain) kaisa hai?
questionEnglish: What is the ruling on raising hands (Rafa-ul-Yadain) before and after Ruku?
questionHindi: रुकू में जाते और उठते समय रफ़ा-उल-यदैन (हाथ उठाना) कैसा है?
hanafi: Sirf Takbeer-e-Tahrima (shuruat) mein haath uthana Sunnat hai; ruku se pehle aur baad mein nahi (Jami' at-Tirmidhi 257, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ki riwayat).
shafii: Takbeer-e-Tahrima, ruku se pehle, ruku ke baad aur teesri rakat ke qiyam par haath uthana Sunnat hai (Sahih al-Bukhari 735).
maliki: Mashhoor Maliki qaul mein sirf Takbeer-e-Tahrima par haath uthaya jata hai.
hanbali: Takbeer-e-Tahrima, ruku se pehle aur ruku ke baad haath uthana Sunnat hai (Sahih al-Bukhari 735).
jafari: Takbeer-e-Tahrima ke alawa Qunoot ke liye haath uthaya jata hai; ruku se pehle takbeer ke waqt haath uthana mustahab hai.
ahleHadith: Ibn Umar (RA) ki sahih hadees (Sahih al-Bukhari 735, Sahih Muslim 390) ke mutabiq ruku se pehle aur baad Rafa-ul-Yadain karna Sunnat hai.
keywordsHinglish: rafa yadain haath uthana ruku namaz

questionHinglish: Safar mein 4 rakat wali farz namaz kitni padhein (Qasr)?
questionEnglish: How many Rakats should be prayed for 4-Rakat Fard prayers while traveling (Qasr)?
questionHindi: सफ़र में 4 रकत वाली फ़र्ज़ नमाज़ कितनी पढ़ें (क़स्र)?
hanafi: 48 miles (~78 km) ya usse zyada ke safar par 4 rakat wali farz namaz (Zuhr, Asr, Isha) ko 2 rakat (Qasr) padhna wajib hai (Surah An-Nisa 4:101, Sahih Muslim 685).
shafii: ~81 km ke safar par Qasr karna jaiz aur afzal hai; musafir chahe toh do namazein jama bhi kar sakta hai.
maliki: ~80 km ke safar par Qasr karna Sunnat-e-Mu'akkadah hai.
hanbali: ~80 km ke safar par Qasr karna afzal hai aur Zaroorat par Zuhr-Asr ya Maghrib-Isha jama kar sakte hain.
jafari: ~44 km (8 Farsakh) ke safar par 4 rakat wali namaz ko 2 rakat Qasr padhna wajib hai.
ahleHadith: Safar mein 4 rakat wali namaz 2 rakat Qasr padhna Sunnat hai aur safar mein do namazein jama karna bhi sabit hai (Sahih Muslim 685, 704).
